name: University of Chicago
summary: Private research university in Chicago whose undergraduate College is known for its Core curriculum. Its economics department is among the most influential in the world.

internationalTuition.notes: Tuition only; student services fee US$1,677 and other fees extra.

scholarships.name: UChicago need-based aid for international students
scholarships.eligibility: First-year international citizens can receive need-based aid; UChicago meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students who apply for it. International students are also eligible for merit aid.
scholarships.coverage: 100% of demonstrated need; aims to cover tuition and fees, with an international stipend towards other costs
